title: Front-end marketing partnership for boring local trades
one_liner: Own SEO/ads/automation front-end for one pool/HVAC-style operator; they fulfill; optimize for phone calls not clicks.
why_agent_runnable: Partner research, creative, SEO/ads ops drafts, call attribution, and reporting are agent-native. Brandon picks partner and gates money/hire/publish/send.

ops_steps.title: Operator shortlist
ops_steps.detail: Find trades with Maps density, strong reviews, weak marketing; score partnership fit.

ops_steps.title: Brandon partner pick
ops_steps.detail: Choose one operator; approve outreach identity.

ops_steps.title: Partnership memo
ops_steps.detail: Draft revenue-share or retainer terms, KPIs (booked jobs), exclusivity — legal review Brandon.

ops_steps.title: Front-end asset pack
ops_steps.detail: SEO pages, ads creatives, follow-up sequences, review automation drafts.

ops_steps.title: Publish + ads spend
ops_steps.detail: Approve go-live and budgets on partner brand or shared brand.

ops_steps.title: Call ops dashboard
ops_steps.detail: Attribute calls→jobs; weekly report; draft partner updates (send gate).

ops_steps.title: Scale or swap
ops_steps.detail: Propose next geo/trade or kill based on booked-job CAC.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.rev_share_or_retainer: retainer $1k-5k/mo and/or rev-share on booked jobs (negotiated)
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: No wrench work; margin depends on ad efficiency and partner close rate. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1-2: operator shortlist with Maps evidence
Day 7: Brandon send gate for partner outreach
kill_criteria: No willing operator after 15 Brandon-approved outreaches
Partner close rate too low to hit agreed CAC after 30 days ads
Partner refuses call tracking / data sharing
Brandon declines further ad spend or partnership terms
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
